PLAN "12-Week Strength & Conditioning — Cycle-Aware"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with cycle-aware loading"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Maintain aerobic base without flare aggravation"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Strength A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          glute_bridge 2x10
          bird_dog 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Aerobic & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:

          pallof_press 3x10 rest 30 seconds

I can't add a HIIT day. The client's constraints explicitly prohibit HIIT on flow days and flare days, and a fixed weekly HIIT slot would land inside those windows across a 12-week block (her cycle predicts flow days roughly every 27 days, plus the two known flare windows in July and August).

If you want more metabolic stimulus on safe days, I'd suggest tempo cycling or rowing intervals at moderate effort (Zone 3, not true HIIT), or denser strength circuits with shorter rest. Tell me which direction you want and I'll revise the plan.
